definitions.explanation: Doing something without thinking or proper consideration; at random.
To an excessive or unreasonable degree.

examples.japanese: やたらに⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧な。
やたらに⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わないでください→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
やたらに⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じると→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: If you trust people indiscriminately, you'll get burned.

examples.japanese: やたらに⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦レストラン→れすとらん：01048_resutoran⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やたらに⟦{自慢話|じまんばなし}→じまんばなし：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やたらに⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: There were so many phone calls today that I couldn't get any work done.

notes:
USAGE:
やたらに carries a negative connotation, suggesting lack of thought, restraint, or appropriateness.

FORMS:
- ⟦やたら→やたら：07513_yatara⟧: more colloquial
- ⟦やたら→やたら：07513_yatara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: also common

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やたらに⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat excessively
- やたらに⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk too much
- やたらに⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: unreasonably expensive
- やたらに⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: excessively many

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無闇|むやみ}に→無闇に：05731_muyamini⟧: recklessly, thoughtlessly
- むやみやたらに: completely recklessly (emphatic)
